comment_data.body:
I haven't investigated the effect on the C code, so I can't say if it's better or worse, but it _might_ be worth typing these as `int` by now.
```suggestion
    cdef int i_input
    cdef int i_output
    cdef int i_gen
    cdef int i_kill
    cdef int i_state
```

milestone.description:
Main features:
- Pattern matching
- Generics / subscripted container types
- `@cython.collection_type()`
- `restrict`
- more vectorcalls
- more thread safety
- smaller modules, more shared code
- remove Py3.8 support, keep Py3.9+
